possible_use: Group mapped verge polygons by route
not_sufficient_for: Does not identify contracted collection routes or haul distance

possible_use: Spatially group management areas and relate them to route sections
not_sufficient_for: Does not provide plant-gate delivery or accessible area by itself

source_definition_english: Code or description for the managed object
possible_use: Filter roadside verge objects from other green objects
not_sufficient_for: Requires code list and data-value review before classification
Does not establish species composition, grass fraction, or biomass yield
Not a machine-accessibility or collection feasibility measure without validated thresholds

source_definition_english: Description of mowing type or method
possible_use: Distinguish mowing-management and likely collection regimes
not_sufficient_for: Does not quantify recovered mass or losses

possible_use: Identify management constraints that may limit harvest timing or frequency
not_sufficient_for: Does not supply measured monthly biomass

source_definition_english: Maintenance frequency for the managed object
possible_use: Translate management frequency into candidate cut-count scenarios
not_sufficient_for: Frequency labels require interpretation and do not specify measured harvest dates or yield

source_definition_english: Zone identifier for the managed object
not_sufficient_for: Does not define ownership, access permission, or contract status

possible_use: Calculate mapped gross candidate area after filtering suitable grass/verge records
not_sufficient_for: Is not equal to mowable grass area, harvestable area, or delivered feedstock

possible_use: Compare mapped geometric area to corrected area as one access-screening input
not_sufficient_for: Correction method and suitability for harvesting need source documentation; not actual collected biomass
Ownership listing is not evidence of feedstock rights or an executed supply contract

possible_use: Identify mowing/maintenance data contact and route-level source
not_sufficient_for: Does not establish that the manager collects or can allocate material to GreenHub

possible_use: Review for local access and operating constraints
not_sufficient_for: Free text must be interpreted and cannot be used as a validated model parameter without review
Not equivalent to a municipality-level delivered-supply total

source_definition_english: Maintenance team responsible for the asset
possible_use: Potential contact/operational grouping for future field-data requests
not_sufficient_for: Does not describe actual equipment hours, route sequence, or quantity collected
